user.title: Add a 3D printer
user.description: What kind of printer is it?

menu_options.bambu_device: Bambu Lab (through the Bambu Lab integration)

electricity.title: Smart plug
electricity.description: The plug the printer is connected to. A plug without energy metering works too: there is just no consumption or cost.

data_description.switch_entity: The switch that powers the printer.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional. Recommended: a cumulative meter is exact, even across restarts.
data_description.price_entity: Needed when a power sensor or energy meter is set. Any entity in EUR/kWh, c€/kWh or EUR/MWh; it may change during a print.
data_description.integration_method: Only used when no energy meter is available.

klipper.title: Klipper printer
klipper.description: Type the printer's IP address. Port, name and web interface are filled in automatically and can be changed later in Configure.

data_description.host: e.g. 192.168.1.89 (add :port only if Moonraker does not use 7125)

bambu_device.title: Bambu Lab printer
bambu_device.description: Select the printer from the Bambu Lab (ha-bambulab) integration. A direct LAN connection that needs no other integration is planned.

bambu.title: Printer entities
bambu.description: {found} entities were detected for {printer}. Check or correct them.

data_description.job_name_entity: Used to tell two prints apart.

klipper_auth.title: API key needed
klipper_auth.description: The printer at {host} only accepts connections with a Moonraker API key. See "Authorization" in the Moonraker documentation for how to get it.

error.unsupported_energy_unit: Unsupported unit (expected Wh, kWh or MWh).
error.unsupported_price_unit: Unsupported unit (expected e.g. EUR/kWh, c€/kWh, EUR/MWh).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the IP address and port, and that the printer is on.
error.price_required: Select the electricity price: a power sensor or energy meter is set.
